final_topology.title: Secure Government Data Center
final_topology.description: A secure government data center with a DMZ, load-balanced web servers, and segmented production, staging, and management zones.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a screened DMZ with a WAF and load-balanced web servers. The core application and database servers are in a production zone, while internal firewalls segment the staging and management networks. Redundant connectivity, content filtering, and SIEM integration are provided.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n29) that manages inventory for all nodes, including servers, firewalls, and endpoints.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple 'data_flow' links (nl_new1 to nl_new18) that document data flows between different zones and nodes.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Production, Staging, and Management, with internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) segmenting these zones.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) that manage traffic between different zones, including servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n21) that provides DNS services to the DMZ and other zones.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n22) that provides MFA services to remote devices (n32, n33).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filter (n23) that provides DNS filtering services to the content filtering zone (z6).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a web proxy (n24) and a DNS filter (n23) that enforce network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a well-segmented network with DMZ, production, staging, and management zones, and internal firewalls to enforce segmentation.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IaC tool (n30) that manages network infrastructure, and secure network protocols are implied by the use of firewalls and switches.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a central AAA server (n25) that provides AAA services to the management zone (z4).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN gateway (n31) that connects remote devices (n32, n33) to the network, and these devices are managed by the AAA server (n25).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n26) that provides intrusion detection services to the production zone (z2).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) that perform traffic filtering between different network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n27) that manages access control for remote devices (n32, n33).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a flow log collector (n34) that collects network traffic flow logs from various zones.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production (z2), staging (z3), and management (z4), which are separated by internal firewalls.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a pen test tool (n35) that performs periodic external penetration tests on the network.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.evidence: {"zone_id": "z7", "name": "External Testing", "zone_type": "external"}
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) but does not explicitly show secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and links to network devices, and label links with secure protocols (e.g., SSH, HTTPS).

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a central AAA server (n25) but does not explicitly show a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links from remote devices to the VPN and from the VPN to the AAA server.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n22) and a network access control (NAC) system (n27), but does not explicitly show how these systems manage access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing remote assets and links to the MFA server and NAC system, and label links with access control policies.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n14) in the DMZ zone, but does not explicitly show collection of network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of network traffic flow log collection is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing network devices that collect traffic flow logs and links to the SIEM.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing zone (z7) and a link (zl6) from the Production zone to the External Testing zone, but does not explicitly show a penetration testing process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a penetration testing process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing tool and links to the External Testing zone and relevant network devices.
